summary: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc. furnished a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 30, 2026, disclosing a press release announcing a follow-on order for one RIO 360 security unit from an existing global healthcare technology customer. The order, placed roughly 15 days after a prior RIO 360 order from the same customer, is earmarked for a separate facility to deter after-hours trespassing. No price, contract value, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or close date was disclosed. The filing is an ordinary product-order announcement, not a special situation; watch for cumulative order momentum and revenue recognition cadence, not arbitrage.
